designSystemScope: Separate Figma design-system board for a sneaker ecommerce homepage template with velocity hero, product launch wall, fit finder, product/category cards, cart cues, trust proof, drop calendar, deal modules, and placeholder guidance.

spacingTokens.scale: 8px base scale with tight commerce rhythm

components: product card with price and cart action

states.default: volt action state for high urgency
states.active: blue active state for selected fit or product mode

componentAnatomy.card: image placeholder, product title, price, cart action, commerce label
componentAnatomy.navigation: brand, launch links, fit finder, shop CTA
componentAnatomy.header: editable sneaker commerce nav with drop CTA
componentAnatomy.footer: brand, explore links, shop links, source notes
componentAnatomy.cta: loyalty command bar and weekly deal modules
componentAnatomy.placeholder: sneaker, athlete, category, deal, and CTA product image clues
componentAnatomy.product: launch wall and discovery grid product cards
componentAnatomy.category: road, court, and street lane cards
componentAnatomy.cart: add-to-cart and cart cue inside product modules
componentAnatomy.trust: performance comparison, customer quote, return and exchange cues

usageRules: Use volt for urgency and conversion, blue for selected or exploratory states.
Keep product, category, cart, and trust cues visible before the final CTA.
Use dark surfaces for performance proof and launch urgency instead of a soft decor rhythm.

surfaceEffectTokens.cardShadow: dark performance card shadow with compact depth
surfaceEffectTokens.heroDepth: dark console with neon gradient product placeholder
surfaceEffectTokens.borderStroke: pale green commerce border for product cards

placeholderRules: Use image placeholder: [purpose] for sneaker products, athlete photos, category cards, deal modules, and final CTA images.
Keep all commerce imagery replaceable in source.
Do not use final generated shoe photography unless explicitly requested.
